purpose: Evaluate a complete host-only joint tilt/accelerometer-bias correction and replay transaction before any production ESKF change.

solver_boundary.state_transaction: complete 15D nominal-state injection plus attitude reset Jacobian followed by canonical replay

development_acceptance: Every trial executes and every candidate replay remains healthy with zero navigation recovery.
The corrected replay preserves the baseline accepted position/velocity event schedule.
Train and tune each improve mean terminal horizontal-bias P95 by at least 0.005 m/s2.
At least 75% of signed nonzero trajectory/vector groups improve.
No zero-bias trial regresses terminal horizontal-bias P95 by more than 0.005 m/s2.
No trial regresses post-correction attitude RMSE by more than 0.05 deg.
limits: This is an opened development matrix and cannot serve as a sealed release holdout.
The solver uses diagonal innovation covariance and idealized synthetic GNSS timing.
No thermal drift, bias random walk, vibration, lever arm, selector switch, or target timing is represented.
Passing permits a separately frozen candidate, not production or control authority.
